input.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $worlds = Get-ChildItem -Directory '.palimpsest/worlds' | Select-Object -ExpandProperty FullName; $world = $null; foreach ($w in $worlds) { if (Test-Path -LiteralPath ($w + '/deliverables/partial.md')) { $world = $w; break } }; if ($null -eq $world) { Write-Output 'NO_RETAINED_WORLD'; exit 3 }; $partial = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath ($world + '/deliverables/partial.md'); $measured = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath 'sources/measured-corridor.md'; $pricing = ($partial -split '## Assumptions')[0].Trim(); $content = "# Deployment package (synthesized)`n`n" + $pricing + "`n`n## Current measured basis`n`n" + $measured.Trim() + "`n`n## Reuse note`n`nThe vendor pricing above is inherited from the retained worker commit; the baseline corridor assumption is NOT carried forward.`n"; Set-Content -LiteralPath ($world + '/deliverables/package.md') -Value $content -Encoding utf8; git -C $world add -A; git -C $world -c user.email=pwrs@fixture.invalid -c 'user.name=PWRS principal' commit -qm 'principal synthesis from retained worker work'; Write-Output ('WORLD=' + $world); git -C $world rev-parse HEAD
